ogtr:DIR-165.name: DIR 165 — GM wheat field trial (iron uptake & bioavailability)
ogtr:DIR-165.desc: Wheat genetically modified for altered iron uptake, transport and bioavailability and for enhanced yield, carrying antibiotic and herbicide selectable markers. Sites and dates are not restated on the summary page used to build this record — open the licence for them. Marker parked at the national centroid, so treat the position as unknown rather than approximate.
